title: Amelia | Pastel Grid Blouse for Effortless Summer Style
bodyHtml:
Soft pastels meet modern ease in this charming blouse. Amelia's pastel grid blouse pairs soft blue and yellow checks with a relaxed cut that moves beautifully without clinging. It's the kind of piece that works just as well at a weekend brunch in Melbourne as it does for a laid-back day at home—fresh, light, and endlessly versatile.

Why you'll love it

  • Cheerful pastel grid pattern that feels contemporary and playful
  • Relaxed fit with a button-down front for easy layering and all-day wear
  • Soft, lightweight fabric that breathes beautifully in warm weather
  • Effortlessly transitions from casual coffee dates to weekend outings
  • Pairs perfectly with white trousers, shorts, or your favourite denim
  • Works brilliantly as a layer over a slip dress for cooler evenings
  • Hard to find this level of thoughtful design at this price point
